Name: JojaBite TV Dinners
Author: Sable17
Description:
[quote][size=4]You can always have a quick bite with [color=#6d9eeb][b]JojaBites[/b][/color]![/size][/quote]
JojaMart’s freezer section now stocks [color=#6d9eeb][b]JojaBite[/b][/color] TV Dinners, and Microwaves to "cook" them in!
Perfect for those nights you’re too tired to... chew much.
[b]
JojaMart's freezer wall is now a shop! Simply walk to the back of the store and start browsing.
[/b]
• 17 frozen [color=#6d9eeb][b]JojaBite [/b][/color]Meals. The flavors offered are [b]unique [/b]to each season!
﻿   - They require Microwaving!
﻿   - Super cheap energy recovery and small skill boosts.
﻿   - The [b]Breakfast [/b]TV Dinner restores Health/Energy, has [b]no buffs[/b], and is sold year-round.

• [color=#6d9eeb][b]JojaMilk [/b][/color](The sign does say "Milk" after all...)
﻿ ﻿    - Cheap energy recovery and [b]+1 Speed[/b] for a very short time.

• [b][color=#6d9eeb]Joja Egg Carton[/color][/b]
﻿    ﻿- Open the Carton for (up to) 6 eggs!
﻿    - Can be used in cooking if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38862]Flexible Cooking[/url]!

• [b][color=#6d9eeb]JojaBite Ice Cream [/color][/b](Every freezer section needs ice cream...)
﻿ ﻿   - Energy recovery and good skill boosts, but with a rough speed debuff.
﻿    ﻿- The buff/debuff has a [b]unique ID[/b], so it doesn't overwrite traditional food/drink buffs, only other [b]JojaBite Ice Cream buffs[/b]. So perhaps you can counteract the debuff and stack them with other buffs...

• Placeable [color=#6d9eeb][b]Microwave [/b][/color](Machine) cooks any JojaBite Frozen Meal in [b]20 in-game minutes
[/b] ﻿   - [b]Sold at the two blue boxes on the right, near the freezers (see picture)[/b]
﻿   - [b]Eight [/b]table color options pulled from the vanilla spritesheets
﻿   - Only [b]two [/b]variants for sale per season
﻿   - Microwave lights up when it's... Microwaving
﻿   - Dad will send you an old Microwave in the mail!

Check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37717]JojaPantry [/url]for canned produce, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38939]JojaMills Breakfast[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38012]JojaFizzy Energy Drinks[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37365]JojaSweets Candy[/url], or[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38341] JojaFresh Healthy Snacks[/url] for more snacks!

There's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39109]JojaGrowth Fertilizer[/url] for your fields, or even [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38103]JojaFlex - Freelance Contracts[/url] if you'd like a side job!

[b]Requirements[/b]
• Stardew Valley 1.6+
• SMAPI
• Content Patcher
• SpaceCore

Doesn't edit the JojaMart map. Should be compatible with mods that edit the store, as long as they don't remove the freezers on the back wall.

Compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded. (Used in Screenshots. Also in screenshot: Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn + SVE patch., VPR-Inspired UI, Covehn's Cozy Farmhouse, Soft Farmer)

Highly recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25681]Drink Water and Eat Frozen[/url] if you want an alternative! My love of it gave me inspiration for this mod!
